properties.name: breakpoint
properties.description: Container width below which panels become modal drawers, in CSS pixels.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Stable panel key, unique within its Root.

properties.name: rail
properties.description: Optional replacement for the collapsed desktop rail.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name and tooltip text when the panel is collapsed to its rail.

properties.name: element
properties.description:
Bindable reference to the rendered DOM element. Type is the union of

properties.name: unstyled
properties.description: Skip the variant/size base classes and render with `class` alone.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Controlled visual state. Loading remains focusable and refuses activation.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Convenience alias for `status="loading"`.

properties.name: panel
properties.description: Target panel key; omit inside that Panel.
